mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints set compensation_status = #{status}, complaints_status = 1 where id = #{id}

update ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base
retention_money_balance = #{param.payPrice},
retention_money_withdrawal = #{param.payPrice1},
retention_money_payment = #{param.payPrice2},
accumulated_compensation = #{param.payPrice3},
retention_status = #{param.retentionStatus},
retention_money_limit = #{param.retentionMoneyLimit},
payment_time = #{param.paymentTime},
where shop_id = #{param.shopId}
update ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common set common_state = 0 where common_state = 1 and shop_id = #{param}
mapper.select: select id, compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, ooc.create_time, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, ooc.user_id, ooc.shop_id, sb.user_id as sellUserId from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints ooc left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on sb.supplier_shop_id = ooc.shop_id where compensation_status = 0 and ooc.failure_time between now() and #{date}

SELECT id, compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, ooc.create_time, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, ooc.user_id, ooc.shop_id, sb.user_id AS sellUserId FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints ooc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = ooc.shop_id WHERE complaints_status = 0 AND now() >= failure_time

SELECT sb.retention_money_balance AS retentionMoneyBalance, sb.retention_money_withdrawal AS retentionMoneyWithdrawal, sb.retention_money_payment AS retentionMoneyPayment, sb.retention_money_limit AS retentionMoneyLimit, sb.retention_status AS retentionStatus, sb.accumulated_compensation AS accumulatedCompensation, sb.user_id, sb.supplier_shop_id, ui.user_mobile FROM ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui ON ui.user_id = sb.user_id WHERE sb.supplier_shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT shop_id, order_create_time, user_id FROM (SELECT oob.shop_id, min(order_create_time) AS order_create_time, sb.user_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob inner JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = oob.shop_id WHERE order_status NOT IN (1, 7) and sb.first_retention = 1 and oob.shop_id <> 0 GROUP BY shop_id ORDER BY order_create_time) a GROUP BY shop_id

select config_key, op_type, config_value, op_value, config_comment, config_enable from ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_sys_configs where config_type = #{configType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by config_sort asc

SELECT cat_id, refund_ratio, cat_level FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_cat WHERE cat_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT cat_id FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common WHERE common_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oog.common_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog ON oob.order_id = oog.order_id WHERE oob.shop_id = #{shopId} and cat_level = 3 and oob.order_create_time BETWEEN #{starttime} and #{endtime} and order_status not in (1, 7)))

select t.refund_ratio from (select @r as _id, (select refund_ratio from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_cat where cat_id = _id) as refund_ratio, (select @r := cat_parent_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_cat where cat_id = _id) as cat_parent_id from (select @r := #{catId}) temp , ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_cat a where @r!=0 ORDER BY cat_parent_id asc ) as t

SELECT supplier_shop_id, payment_time, user_id, retention_money_payment, retention_money_balance, retention_money_withdrawal, retention_money_limit, retention_status FROM ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base WHERE retention_status = 3 or (retention_status = 2 and CURDATE() > DATE_ADD(payment_time, INTERVAL 3 DAY))
SELECT a.user_id, a.user_money_pending_settlement, a.user_money, a.user_money_frozen, a.user_recharge_card FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_resource a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, create_time, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, user_id, shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} and compensation_status = 0 and complaints_status = 1
ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT common_id FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common WHERE common_state = 1 AND shop_id = #{param}

SELECT DISTINCT sb.supplier_shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = oob.shop_id WHERE order_create_time BETWEEN #{starttime} and #{endtime} and sb.shop_status = 3
